name: strata-workshop
description: Draft AnythingLLM customizations from chat: custom agent skills, Agent Flows, MCP servers and workspace system prompts. Call action=guide with the kind first to get the exact format. Drafted skills, flows and MCP servers stay off until the user switches them on in Settings; nothing can be switched on or deleted from here.
author: strata

action.description: One of: guide, list, draft_skill, draft_flow, draft_mcp, workspace.

kind.description: For guide and list: skill, flow, mcp or workspace.

hubId.description: draft_skill: the skill's id, lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

manifest.description: draft_skill: plugin.json as a JSON string.

handler.description: draft_skill: the full JavaScript source of handler.js.

config.description: draft_flow: the flow as a JSON string with description and steps.

uuid.description: draft_flow: an existing flow's uuid, to redraft it.

command.description: draft_mcp: the command to launch, e.g. npx.

args.description: draft_mcp: the arguments as a JSON array of strings.

env.description: draft_mcp: environment variables as a JSON object of strings.

slug.description: workspace: an existing workspace's slug, to update it.

examples.prompt: How do I make a custom skill?
